tsundoku.description:
Tsundoku is free and open source novel and manga reader for Android. Tsundoku, our novel-focused fork of Mihon was recently released and just got its first update!

Notable Features:

Infinite scroll support

Mihon's Download Ahead works fluidly

Customizable reader with option to use webview for custom CSS/JS

Supports Mihon-type extensions (There's at least one Novel source repo) and lnreader (js) plugins

EPUB/TXT/HTML support for local novels (import/export)

Novel specific trackers like OpenNovel and NovelUpdates

TTS and AI translation support (ollama,gemini,chatgpt ect)

Filter presets for each source

Delay/throttling settings to avoid straining or harming sources

Many features for organizing and optimizing large libraries

Active devs who have time to address issues that may arise from a new app! (With official stable and beta versions, and auto update options like Mihon!)

Supports lnreader backup imports
